items.titleJa: {商店街|しょうてんがい}ラジオの{天気予報|てんきよほう}

lines.kana: しょうてんがいのみなさん、きょうはみずをたくさんのんで、むりをしないでください。

items.recapEn: The arcade radio's two o'clock forecast for Shizuoka on a hot, clear afternoon: a typhoon far south is moving north but should miss the city, maybe passing over the nearby sea. It is 32 degrees now, 34 by three, 26 tonight, about 31 tomorrow. South wind from evening, rain tomorrow morning; close windows, no swimming, next forecast at five.

items.recapEn: At closing time Hana and Ken stop at Matsumoto-san's shop, and Ken buys a box of ten Abekawa mochi for breakfast by the Abe River. The southern sky looks like rain, but the evening news says the typhoon will pass far out at sea, so Tanaka-san seems right. Matsumoto-san starts at four and invites Ken to watch; Hana will sleep.
